host.local: A repository on this computer or on a network drive

validation.nameMissing: Give the remote a name, e.g. “origin”.
validation.nameSpaces: Spaces aren't allowed in the name.
validation.nameEdges: The name can't start with “-”, “/” or “.” and can't end with “/”, “.” or “.lock”.
validation.pushMissing: Enter the push URL or turn off “Separate push URL”.

remove.title: Remove remote “{{name}}”?
remove.body: The connection and all remote branches {{name}}/… disappear from this repository; branches that track it lose their upstream. Nothing changes on the server. Undo brings the remote back.

editDescription: Change the name and addresses. Remote branches and upstreams follow along when renaming.
addDescription: Connects this repository to another server or folder.

gone.title: The remote “{{name}}” no longer exists
gone.body: It was removed or renamed in the meantime, maybe in the terminal. Close the dialog and select it again.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Short and without spaces. The first remote is usually called “origin”.

pushUrl.toggleHint: In case you fetch from one address and push to another.
pushUrl.label: Push URL

masked: The credentials in the URL are hidden as “***”. If you leave the asterisks, the stored credentials are kept.
fetchAfterHint: Fetches this remote's branches and tags so they appear in the graph.
